info.name: TiDB Cloud API Keys Statistics API

params.name: table
params.description: The table name within the specified database.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Optional Unix timestamp to retrieve historical statistics at a specific point in time.

items.docs: Returns the optimizer statistics for the specified table in JSON format. Statistics include histogram data, count-min sketch approximations, and correlation coefficients used by the TiDB query optimizer when generating execution plans. Optionally specify a timestamp to retrieve historical statistics.
